claim: Cards, figures and a floating row of shortcut links sit on frosted see-through panels with a soft blur (6px backdrop blur on .glass-surface)
Three looks: Clarity teal and orange on pale mint; Prism cyan and pink on pale blue with larger headings and more spacing; Graphite slate and amber on near-black
Eight extra blocks, six of which use the frosted panel (depth hero and refraction grid use translucent panes and tiles without blur)
Blocks include a call to action and a showcase of cards with images
A strip of figures counts up once (count-up module is in theme-foundation; this block renders its markup)
Editors fill in each block's wording in an editing form in the widget editor, for its heading, summary, items, images, links and style
Four blocks show built-in sample headings when their wording is empty
The footer shows the site name and a copyright line built from the site title and the year
Sections shared from Foundation do not get the blur (blur only on .glass-surface; header and footer use the opaque chrome surface)
Needs the Foundation theme and Layout Builder installed
On a dark device the header and the block panels and tiles turn dark in all three looks (theme surface and foreground swapped)
Private preview before applying, through the Core Marketplace theme page (page class lives in Core; this package contributes the entry)
